## Anything that needs a matching change on the site

<!-- Tick only if relevant, and describe it. Both of these will fail the site's build if they
     land here alone, so flagging them saves a round trip. -->

- [ ] This changes a **money figure** (fee, processing passthrough, collection window)
- [ ] This adds or renames a **category** directory
- [ ] This renames or deletes an article slug (its URL changes, and existing links break)
